message: Integer literal `007` has a leading zero; write it without leading zeros.
Integer literal `00` has a leading zero; write it without leading zeros.
Hexadecimal literal `0x1F` is not supported in v0.1; write integers in decimal.
Binary literal `0b101` is not supported in v0.1; write integers in decimal.
Literal `1_000` uses digit separators, which are not supported in v0.1.
Numeric literal `10u32` has the suffix `u32`, which is not supported in v0.1; numeric literals have no suffixes.
Float literal `1.` has no digits after the decimal point; floats need digits on both sides of the point.
Float literal `.5` has no digits before the decimal point; floats need digits on both sides of the point.
Float literal `1e3` has an exponent but no decimal point; floats need digits on both sides of the point.
Float literal `1.e3` has no digits after the decimal point; floats need digits on both sides of the point.
Float literal `007.5` has a leading zero; write it without leading zeros.
Literal `1_000.5` uses digit separators, which are not supported in v0.1.
